article_content: Kommissæren for Standarder i Forsamlingen vil gennemgå, hvordan medlemmer af forsamlingen håndterer politiske lobbyister. Forsamlingens formand, Rosemary Butler, har anmodet om denne gennemgang. Dette sker efter, at Westminster-regeringen har startet en høring om, hvorvidt der skal oprettes et lovpligtigt register over lobbyister med forbindelse til politikere. I 2010 forudsagde David Cameron, at lobbyisme ville blive den 'næste store skandale'. Det forventes, at Gerard Elias QC færdiggør gennemgangen inden efteråret.
translated_content: The Assembly Standards Commissioner will review how Assembly Members interact with political lobbyists. The Assembly's Presiding Officer, Rosemary Butler, has requested this review. This follows the Westminster government's launch of a consultation about creating a statutory register for lobbyists with connections to politicians. Back in 2010, David Cameron predicted that lobbying would be the 'next big scandal.' Gerard Elias QC is expected to finish the review by autumn.

translated_post: Big news for political transparency: The Assembly is reviewing its approach to lobbyists after the UK gov’s new consultation. David Cameron called it—the next big scandal? #Lobbying #Politics #Transparency

article_content: En af grundlæggerne af Aberystwyth Arts Centre, Roger Tomlinson, mener, at et uafhængigt selvejende selskab bør stå for ledelsen af kunstcentret for at forhindre en forringelse af centrets situation. Tomlinson, centrets første leder og nu international kunstkonsulent, påpeger, at økonomisk pres på universitetet kan bringe centrets uafhængighed og hensynet til offentligheden i fare. Siden 1. august har centret været en del af Institut for Litteratur, Sprog og Kreative Kunstarter ved Aberystwyth Universitet. Tomlinson fremhæver, at økonomiske udfordringer i andre afdelinger kan true centrets drift og have negative konsekvenser for offentligheden. Aberystwyth Universitet fremhæver dog, at de samarbejder med flere eksterne parter og har etableret et nyt kunstfagligt rådgivningsudvalg, som har fungeret i omkring 18 måneder. Centret åbnede i 1972. Tidligere på året blev en strategi offentliggjort, der betyder, at centret nu indgår i universitetets akademiske struktur, og lederen refererer til universitetet. Tomlinson mener, at dette vil gøre centret mere fokuseret på universitetet end offentligheden. Han foreslår et selvstændigt selvejende selskab, typisk et aktieselskab registreret som velgørenhed. Centrets ledelse skulle i givet fald referere til et officielt organ, der mødes mindst fire gange årligt og godkender centrets politikker og program. Formålet med en sådan model er at balancere offentlighedens og investorernes interesser samt beskytte universitetet mod kritik. En risiko ved den nuværende model er, at midler kan blive brugt til at hjælpe andre universitetsafdelinger frem for centret selv. Det er ikke første gang, at der er bekymring om ledelsen af centret. Lokale har protesteret mod ændringerne, og i fredags blev der afholdt et offentligt møde herom. På campus har der også været protester efter suspensionen af direktør Alan Hewson og driftschef Auriel Martin. Hewson er nu gået på pension. Handlingsudvalget støtter Tomlinsons forslag. Blandt støtterne er den lokale kunstner Stephen West. Da centret åbnede, havde det eget budget og rapporterede direkte til Arts Council of Wales. Bekymringen er, at den akademiske tilknytning kan underminere centrets kunstneriske uafhængighed, særligt hvis universitetet anvender centrets lokaler til akademiske formål. Sarah Prescott, leder for litteratur, sprog og kreative kunstarter ved universitetet, understreger de allerede eksisterende samarbejder med eksterne aktører og det nye rådgivningsudvalg. Hun fremhæver vigtigheden af dialog med lokalbefolkningen og behovet for tid til at udvikle nye samarbejdsformer. Arts Council of Wales yder årligt mere end 500.000 pund til centret. Rådets direktør Nick Capaldi deltog i det offentlige møde i sidste uge og udtalte til BBC Cymru, at han er bekymret for den negative stemning lokalt. Capaldi mener, at en uafhængig model fungerer godt flere steder, men at det er nødvendigt at overveje flere modeller. Han peger på, at uafhængighed kan skabe klarhed og selvstyre, men samarbejde med andre institutioner og deling af omkostninger også kan være fordelagtigt. Han fastslår, at valget af ledelsesmodel kræver grundige overvejelser og bekræfter Arts Council’s engagement i at samarbejde med universitetet om at ansætte en ny leder for centret.
translated_content: One of the founders of Aberystwyth Arts Centre, Roger Tomlinson, believes that an independent trust should manage the arts centre to prevent its situation from deteriorating. Tomlinson, the centre's first director and now an international arts consultant, points out that financial pressures on the university could threaten the centre’s independence and the public interest. Since August 1, the centre has been part of the Institute of Literature, Languages and Creative Arts at Aberystwyth University. Tomlinson highlights that financial challenges in other departments could jeopardize the centre's operations and negatively impact the public. Aberystwyth University, however, emphasizes that they collaborate with several external partners and have established a new arts advisory board, which has been active for about 18 months. The centre opened in 1972. Earlier this year, a strategy was released that means the centre is now part of the university's academic structure, and its director reports to the university. Tomlinson believes this will make the centre more focused on serving the university rather than the public. He suggests an independent trust, typically a company registered as a charity. In that case, the centre’s management would report to an official body that meets at least four times a year and approves the centre's policies and programme. The purpose of such a model is to balance the interests of the public and investors and protect the university from criticism. One risk of the current model is that funds might be used to support other university departments rather than the centre itself. This is not the first time there have been concerns about the centre’s management. Local residents have protested against the changes, and a public meeting was held last Friday. There have also been campus protests following the suspension of director Alan Hewson and operations manager Auriel Martin. Hewson has now retired. The action committee supports Tomlinson's proposal. Among the supporters is local artist Stephen West. When the centre opened, it had its own budget and reported directly to the Arts Council of Wales. The concern is that the academic affiliation could undermine the centre's artistic independence, especially if the university uses the centre’s facilities for academic purposes. Sarah Prescott, head of literature, languages and creative arts at the university, emphasizes the already existing collaborations with external partners and the new advisory board. She highlights the importance of dialogue with the local community and the need for time to develop new ways of working together. The Arts Council of Wales provides more than £500,000 in annual funding to the centre. The council’s director, Nick Capaldi, attended the public meeting last week and told BBC Cymru he is concerned about negative local sentiment. Capaldi believes an independent model works well in many places, but that it’s necessary to consider several models. He points out that independence can create clarity and self-governance, but cooperation with other institutions and cost-sharing can also be beneficial. He concludes that choosing a management model requires careful thought and confirms the Arts Council's commitment to working with the university to appoint a new director for the centre.

article_content: Den Nationale Eisteddfod har udnævnt en ny teknisk leder, en central rolle med ansvar for at forberede og rydde hele festivalpladsen. Huw Aled Jones begynder sit arbejde i starten af september, når nuværende leder Alan Gwynant overlader ansvaret efter 25 år. Huw Aled har stor erfaring som produktions-, teknisk- og scenemanager i tv-branchen og ved livebegivenheder i Wales og internationalt. Ved annonceringen sagde Elfed Roberts, Eisteddfods administrerende direktør: 'Jeg er meget glad for, at vi har udnævnt Huw Aled Jones som teknisk leder.' Han har særlig erfaring på området og vil fortsætte med at bygge på det stærke fundament, som det tekniske team har skabt gennem de seneste år. Huw har fungeret som produktionsleder for BBC under Eisteddfod det sidste årti, så han har fremragende indsigt i arbejdet og festivalens behov samt kendskab til de udfordringer, organisationer møder under ugen. Vi vil også gerne anerkende Alan Gwynant, som har været ansvarlig for den tekniske side af Eisteddfod siden 1988 – en periode, hvor både vores egne og lovgivningsmæssige krav, såsom sundhed og sikkerhed, har udviklet sig væsentligt. Alan har ledet dette arbejde gennem årene, og når vi nu byder Huw velkommen til teamet, ønsker vi Alan alt godt med pensionen og takker for hans engagement. Huw Aled Jones udtalte: 'Jeg er meget glad for muligheden for at blive en del af Eisteddfod-teamet og ser frem til de kommende udfordringer.' Det er en spændende tid for festivalen, og med aftalte planer flere år frem ser jeg frem til at arbejde over hele Wales for at sikre festivalens fortsatte succes, som står mit hjerte nær. Det bliver helt sikkert en udfordrende rolle, og jeg glæder mig til at arbejde sammen med kolleger, ledere og alle Eisteddfods frivillige de næste år.'
translated_content: The National Eisteddfod has appointed a new Technical Head, a key role responsible for preparing and clearing the entire festival site. Huw Aled Jones will begin his work at the start of September, as the current head Alan Gwynant hands over responsibility after 25 years. Huw Aled has significant experience as a production, technical, and stage manager in broadcasting and live events in Wales and internationally. At the announcement, Elfed Roberts, Eisteddfod's Chief Executive, said: 'I am very pleased that we have appointed Huw Aled Jones as Technical Head.' He has special experience in the field and will continue to build on the strong foundation the technical team has established over recent years. Huw has served as production manager for the BBC at the Eisteddfod over the past decade, so he has excellent insight into the festival's operations and needs, as well as knowledge of the challenges organizations face during the week. We would also like to recognize Alan Gwynant, who has been responsible for the technical side of the Eisteddfod since 1988 – during a period when both our own and legal requirements, such as health and safety, have developed significantly. Alan has led this work over the years, and as we welcome Huw to the team, we wish Alan all the best with his retirement and thank him for his dedication. Huw Aled Jones stated: 'I am very happy for the opportunity to become part of the Eisteddfod team and look forward to the challenges ahead.' It is an exciting time for the festival, and with plans in place for several years ahead, I look forward to working across Wales to ensure the ongoing success of a festival close to my heart. It will certainly be a challenging role, and I look forward to working with colleagues, management, and all of the Eisteddfod’s volunteers over the coming years.'

translated_post: Big news for the Eisteddfod! Huw Aled Jones is the new Technical Head, taking over after 25 years of Alan Gwynant’s amazing work. Wishing both all the best in their new adventures! #Eisteddfod #WelshCulture #News

article_content: S4C bliver betragtet som en af de bedst finansierede tv-stationer i verden, ifølge Storbritanniens kulturminister Ed Vaizey. Han udtalte sig om kanalen under en debat i det britiske parlament om offentlig tv. I regnskabsåret 2014-2015 modtog S4C 7 millioner pund fra den britiske regering og hele 76 millioner pund fra BBC via licensbetalingen. Vaizey understregede, at S4C fortsætter med at være blandt de tv-stationer, der får den mest generøse finansiering – ikke kun i Storbritannien, men på verdensplan. Hywel Williams, parlamentsmedlem fra Plaid Cymru for Arfon, påpegede dog, at S4C har været ramt af betydelige nedskæringer i støtten. Hovedparten af S4C’s budget kommer fra BBC’s licensindtægt, mens resten finansieres af den britiske regering og noget kommerciel indtjening. Regeringens anbefalinger om S4C’s fremtid bliver offentliggjort torsdag. Vaizey roste S4C for dens fremragende arbejde med at fremme walisisk-sprogede programmer. Williams udtrykte bekymring over britisk og amerikansk kulturpåvirkning på walisisk tv. Han nævnte, at vælgerne i Arfon nogle gange kender mere til LAPD end til det lokale nordwalisisk politi. Han mente, at tv og radio bør afspejle samfundet, de tjener, og pegede på svagheder i den trykte journalistik. Williams tilføjede, at mange i Wales typisk læser aviser fra England og London, hvilket betyder, at dækningen af walisisk samfund og politik ofte er meget begrænset og næsten usynlig. Han fandt det positivt, at næsten 300.000 walisiske seere følger BBC Wales' nyhedsprogram 'Wales Today', men var bekymret over, at den walisiske publikumsråds vurdering viser, at udbuddet af engelsksprogede tv-programmer i Wales nu er meget tæt på grænsen.
translated_content: S4C is considered one of the best-funded television channels in the world, according to the UK's Culture Minister, Ed Vaizey. He made these remarks about the channel during a debate in the UK parliament on public broadcasting. For the 2014-2015 financial year, S4C received £7 million from the UK government and £76 million from the BBC through license fees. Vaizey stressed that S4C remains among the most generously funded broadcasters not only in the UK but worldwide. However, Hywel Williams, MP from Plaid Cymru for Arfon, pointed out that S4C has suffered significant funding cuts. The majority of S4C’s budget comes from the BBC license fee, with the rest funded by the UK government and some commercial revenue. The government’s recommendations regarding S4C’s future will be published on Thursday. Vaizey praised S4C for its outstanding work in promoting Welsh-language programming. Williams expressed concern over British and American cultural influence on Welsh television, saying that sometimes his constituents in Arfon know more about the LAPD than about their own North Wales Police. He argued that TV and radio should reflect the communities they serve, highlighting weaknesses in print journalism. Williams added that many people in Wales tend to read newspapers from England and London, meaning Welsh life and especially Welsh politics receive very little attention. He was encouraged that nearly 300,000 viewers in Wales watch BBC Wales’ news program 'Wales Today' on TV, but worried that the Welsh Audience Council’s assessment found provision of English-language TV programming in Wales is now close to its lowest point.
post_content: S4C er stadig blandt verdens mest gavmilde tv-stationer! 📺💷 Men store nedskæringer og britisk/amerikansk kultur fylder for meget, mener MP’er. BBC Wales' nyheder ses af næsten 300.000 walisere, men dækningen af Wales mangler stadig. #S4C #WalisiskTV
translated_post: S4C stays one of the world's best-funded TV channels! 🇬🇧💰 But big funding cuts and too much UK/US influence worry local MPs. BBC Wales' news gets nearly 300k viewers, but coverage of Welsh life is still lacking. #WelshTV #S4C #MediaMatters

article_content: Et nyt projekt til 500 millioner pund skal forvandle et forfaldent område midt i Cardiff. Udviklingen på Dumballs Road vil omfatte 2.150 boliger, en folkeskole, butikker og restauranter. Cardiffs byrådsleder, Phil Bale, har taget positivt imod projektet, da det ikke er afhængigt af offentlige midler. Et tidligere forslag om at finansiere boligerne via lån og tilbagebetaling blev afvist. Arbejdet forventes at begynde på stedet i foråret 2015. Ifølge administrerende direktør for udviklingsfirmaet Bellerophon, Richard Daley, er dette en 'historisk dag' for Cardiff. Dumballs Road-området er det sidste centrale landområde i byen, der stadig trænger til fornyelse. Projektet, som er et omdrejningspunkt for byens Enterprise zone, forventes at give et økonomisk løft og skabe tusindvis af arbejdspladser under og efter byggeriet.
translated_content: A new £500 million project will transform a derelict area in the heart of Cardiff. The development on Dumballs Road will include 2,150 homes, a primary school, shops, and restaurants. Cardiff council leader Phil Bale has welcomed the project, as it does not rely on public funds. A previous proposal to finance the homes through loans and repayment was rejected. Work is expected to begin on site in the spring of 2015. According to the CEO of development firm Bellerophon, Richard Daley, this is a 'historic day' for Cardiff. The Dumballs Road area is the last central land in the city still in need of renewal. The project, which is a focal point for the city's Enterprise Zone, is expected to provide an economic boost and create thousands of jobs during and after construction.

article_content: En ny rapport offentliggjort denne uge hævder, at der mangler logik bag det nuværende system for selvstyre (devolution) i Wales. Rapporten konkluderer, at yderligere selvstyre kun er et spørgsmål om tid. Desuden understreger den, at fortsat britisk medlemskab af EU er meget vigtigt for Wales. Wales' regering oplyser, at grænserne for selvstyre vil blive gennemgået som del af Silk-kommissionens arbejde. Det britiske akademi og Det walisiske lærde selskab udgav rapporten efter konferencer i maj 2013 ledet af eksperter inden for forvaltning, offentlige udgifter og diplomati. Rapporten undersøger historiske og sociale bånd mellem Wales, resten af Storbritannien og Europa. Den fastslår, at det eksisterende system i Wales ikke giver meget mening, og at spørgsmålet nu handler om hvornår og hvordan mere selvstyre vil blive overført fra Westminster. Ifølge rapporten: 'Der synes at mangle en logisk begrundelse for mange aspekter af selvstyreordningen; Mr. Silk udtalte, at dette ville være i fokus for kommissionens arbejde omkring beføjelserne til Nationalforsamlingen, hvor forskellige modeller for devolution overvejes. I Skotland findes alle beføjelser, medmindre Westminster siger andet, og tilsvarende gælder i Nordirland. Men i Wales er de overførte beføjelser specifikt listet, og alt andet forbliver under britisk myndighed. Er der nogen principiel grund bag dette, eller er det blot tilfældigheder? Hvis der er et princip, kan det modstå kritik? Hvis det er en tilfældighed, er det så en heldig en? Er det blevet fastholdt af dovenskab?' Hvor selvstyregrænsen trækkes, er et omstridt emne på tværs af grænserne. Som svar siger Wales' regering: 'Silk-kommissionen undersøger i øjeblikket beføjelserne for Nationalforsamlingen som anden del af sit arbejde, og grænserne for selvstyret er en del af dette. Det forventes, at den rapporterer sine resultater næste forår, og at regeringen vil nøje overveje anbefalingerne.' Rapporten siger også, at hvis Storbritannien vælger at forlade EU, vil det 'næsten sikkert være skadeligt for Wales.' Desuden ser rapporten på devolutionens indvirkning i andre europæiske lande såsom Belgien, Frankrig, Tyskland og Spanien. Forfatterne afslutter med et klart budskab til borgerne i Wales: 'Nations uden egen stat må selv beslutte, hvad de ønsker.'
translated_content: A new report published this week claims there is a lack of logic behind the current system of devolution in Wales. The report concludes that further devolution is only a matter of time. It also emphasizes that the UK's continued membership in the EU is very important for Wales. The Welsh government states that the boundaries of devolution will be reviewed as part of the Silk Commission's work. The British Academy and the Learned Society of Wales published the report following conferences in May 2013 led by experts in governance, public expenditure, and diplomacy. The report examines the historical and social ties between Wales, the rest of Britain, and Europe. It states that the existing system in Wales makes little sense, and that the question is now when and how—not if—more devolution will be transferred from Westminster. According to the report: 'There seems to be a lack of logical rationale behind many aspects of the devolution settlement; Mr. Silk has stated that this would be a focus of the commission’s work on powers for the National Assembly, considering different models of devolution.' In Scotland, all powers are devolved unless Westminster decides otherwise, and a similar arrangement applies in Northern Ireland. However, in Wales, devolved powers are specifically listed while everything else remains under British authority. Is there a principal reason behind this, or is it simply by chance? If there is a principle, can it withstand scrutiny? If it’s a coincidence, is it a fortunate one? Is it being maintained out of laziness?' Where the line of devolution is drawn is a contentious issue across the borders. In response, the Welsh government says: 'The Silk Commission is currently examining the powers of the National Assembly as the second part of its work, and the boundaries of devolution are part of this process. It is expected to report its findings next spring, and the government will consider the recommendations carefully.' The report also notes that if the UK were to leave the EU, it would ‘almost certainly be damaging to Wales.’ Furthermore, the report looks at the impact of devolution in other European countries such as Belgium, France, Germany, and Spain. The authors conclude with a clear message for the people of Wales: ‘Nations without a state must decide for themselves what they want.’

article_content: En mand blev arresteret efter, at der var blevet efterladt sten midt på vejen i Gwynedd. Stenene forårsagede flere uheld på A499 ved Nantlle samt på B4418 nær Talsarn. I starten af måneden blev en mand kørt på hospitalet med mindre skader, da hans bil ramte en af stenene, som var blevet efterladt på vejen tæt ved Parc Glynllifon. Den 31-årige lokale mand er blevet løsladt mod kaution, mens politiet fortsat efterforsker sagen. Neil Thomas fra Nordwales Politi udtalte: "For nylig er flere sten blevet efterladt på veje, hvilket har forårsaget flere uheld. Dette har ikke kun medført skader på køretøjer, men også sat bilisternes liv i fare. Efter efterforskning af lokale betjente blev en mand anholdt og afhørt, mistænkt for at have forvoldt kriminel skade." Alle med oplysninger om hændelserne bedes kontakte politiet på tlf. 101 eller anonymt igennem Taclo'r Tacle på 0800 555111.
translated_content: A man was arrested after stones were left in the middle of the road in Gwynedd. The stones caused several accidents on the A499 at Nantlle and the B4418 near Talsarn. Earlier in the month, a man was taken to hospital with minor injuries after his car hit one of the stones left on the road near Parc Glynllifon. The 31-year-old local man has been released on bail while police continue their investigation. Neil Thomas from North Wales Police stated: "Recently, several stones have been left on roads, which has caused several accidents. This has not only led to vehicle damage but has also put drivers' lives at risk. Following an investigation by local officers, a man was arrested and questioned on suspicion of causing criminal damage." Anyone with information about the incidents is asked to contact the police on 101 or anonymously via Taclo'r Tacle at 0800 555111.

article_content: Carmarthenshire er den første kommune i Wales, der har dannet en arbejdsgruppe for at forberede en strategi og specifikke planer til støtte for sine landdistrikter efter 2019. Det sker midt i stor usikkerhed om Storbritanniens Brexit-strategi, som har præget diskussionerne ved den store landbrugsmesse i Llanelwedd. Kommunen har netop offentliggjort flere detaljer om sine planer for Swansea Bay City Region – et projekt til en værdi af 1,3 milliarder pund for området. Arbejdsgruppen, ledet af byrådsmedlem Cefin Campbell, bliver tværpolitisk. I denne uge har han på messepladsen holdt møder med landbrugsorganisationer, Menter a Busnes, uddannelsesorganisationen Lantra og Natural Resources Wales om deres behov. "Mange projekter omkring 'City Deal' er placeret i de sydlige, mere urbane dele af kommunen. Med Brexit-usikkerheden ser vi dog behovet for at fokusere på landdistrikterne, hvor vi mangler en klar vision fra både Westminster og Cardiff Bay om løsninger efter Brexit. Vi ser en mulighed for at gå forrest her," siger Cefin Campbell. "Vi vil kortlægge, hvad folk har brug for for at kunne etablere virksomheder på landet. Det gælder alt fra hurtig bredbåndsforbindelse, transportproblemer og det walisiske sprogs levedygtighed til fremtiden for landsbyskoler." Arbejdsgruppen skal udvikle planer, der vil kunne finansieres med midler, som tilbageføres til enten Det Forenede Kongerige eller den walisiske regering fra Bruxelles. Gruppen påbegynder sit arbejde i september.
translated_content: Carmarthenshire is the first county in Wales to have formed a working group to prepare a strategy and specific plans to support its rural areas after 2019. This comes amid major uncertainty surrounding the UK's Brexit strategy, which has influenced discussions at the big agricultural show in Llanelwedd. The council has just released more details about plans for the Swansea Bay City Region—a project worth £1.3 billion to the area. The cross-party working group will be chaired by Councillor Cefin Campbell. This week he held meetings at the showground with farming organizations, Menter a Busnes, the training body Lantra, and Natural Resources Wales to understand their needs. "Many City Deal projects are based in the southern, more urban parts of the county. However, with Brexit uncertainty, we see the need to focus on rural communities, where there is still no clear vision from either Westminster or Cardiff Bay for post-Brexit solutions. We see an opportunity to lead the way here," says Cefin Campbell. "We want to identify what people need to set up businesses in the countryside. That includes everything from high-speed broadband and transport issues to sustaining the Welsh language and the future of village schools." The working group will develop plans eligible for funding from resources returned to either the UK or Welsh government from Brussels. The group will begin its work in September.

article_content: Pontio, det nye kunst- og innovationscenter i Bangor, har netop haft åbning og viser sin første film på tirsdag. Cirka tre fjerdedele af finansieringen kommer fra offentlige midler, især fra den walisiske regering og Arts Council of Wales.

article_content: Parkeringspladser i Bannau Brycheiniog er blevet lukket for offentligheden for at hindre folk i at have sex i deres biler. Dŵr Cymru har placeret betonblokke ved Llwyn Onn-reservoiret for at forhindre parkering. Men nogle vandrere er utilfredse, da blokkene også forhindrer deres adgang. Dŵr Cymru forklarer, at spærringerne blev sat op efter 'flere klager fra offentligheden om asocial adfærd'. Sandra Davies fra Cwm Merthyr Ramblers fortalte BBC Radio 2, at mange ikke er bekendte med de nye forhindringer. 'Jeg har sympati med beboerne, men det går ud over alle,' sagde hun. Hun foreslog, at Dŵr Cymru kunne have brugt en anden type spærring, som blokerede for besøgende om natten, men gav mulighed for parkering om dagen. Dŵr Cymru udtalte, at en af parkeringspladserne ved Llwyn Onn vil være åben om dagen, og at der findes andre muligheder i området. En talsmand tilføjede, at virksomheden arbejder på at forbedre adgangen til reservoiret for vandrere. Men Davies påpegede, at folk, der søger seksuelle aktiviteter i bilerne, bare vil flytte til andre parkeringspladser, og hun vil tage sagen op med Ramblers' hovedkontor.
translated_content: Parking areas in Bannau Brycheiniog have been closed to the public to prevent people from having sex in their cars. Dŵr Cymru has installed concrete blocks at the Llwyn Onn reservoir to block parking. However, some walkers are unhappy as the blocks also block their access. Dŵr Cymru explained that the barriers were set up after 'several complaints from the public about antisocial behavior.' Sandra Davies from Cwm Merthyr Ramblers told BBC Radio 2 that many people are unaware of the new obstacles. 'I sympathize with the residents, but this affects everyone,' she said. She suggested Dŵr Cymru could have used different barriers, ones that would block visitors at night but allow parking during the day. Dŵr Cymru stated that one of the car parks at Llwyn Onn will be open during the day, and that there are other places to park in the area. A spokesperson added that the company is working to improve access to the reservoir for walkers. But Davies pointed out that people looking for sexual activities in their cars would simply move to other parking areas, and she plans to raise the issue with Ramblers' headquarters.

article_content: Wrexham led et nederlag på 1-2 til Forest Green Rovers lørdag, hvilket svækkede deres håb om at vinde Blue Square Premier-rækken. Fleetwood har nu udbygget forspringet i toppen af tabellen til ni point efter deres 2-0-sejr over Mansfield samme dag. Selvom Wrexham har to kampe i hånden, vil de stadig være tre point bag Fleetwood, hvis de vinder begge. Wrexhams bedste chance for at tage titlen kan nu være at slå Fleetwood, når de to hold mødes i Fleetwood 10. april. Jake Speight bragte Wrexham foran med et straffespark efter 20 minutter, efter Jamie Collins nedlagde Mark Creighton i feltet. Matt Taylor udlignede for gæsterne efter 64 minutter, da hjemmeholdets forsvar fejlede. Det blev værre for Wrexham, da James Norwood scorede Forest Green Rovers’ sejrsmål i kampens sidste minut. Det var første gang siden midten af september sidste år, at Wrexham tabte en hjemmekamp i ligaen. I bunden led Newport County et nyt nederlag i kampen for overlevelse. Newport er nu kun ét point over nedrykningsstregen, selvom de har kampe i hånden over for konkurrenterne. Lincoln kom foran da Mark McCammon scorede med hovedet efter 25 minutter. Kort efter fordoblede Nutter hjemmeholdets føring på frispark. Selvom Newport har nået FA Trophy-finalen, har de nu ikke vundet nogen af deres seneste fem ligakampe.
translated_content: Wrexham suffered a 1-2 defeat to Forest Green Rovers on Saturday, weakening their hopes of winning the Blue Square Premier. Fleetwood have now extended their lead at the top of the table to nine points after a 2-0 win over Mansfield on the same day. Even though Wrexham have two games in hand, they would still be three points behind Fleetwood if they won both. Wrexham's best chance of taking the title now may be to beat Fleetwood when the two teams meet in Fleetwood on April 10. Jake Speight put Wrexham in front with a penalty after 20 minutes, after Jamie Collins fouled Mark Creighton in the box. Matt Taylor equalized for the visitors after 64 minutes when the home defense failed. Things got worse for Wrexham when James Norwood scored Forest Green Rovers' winning goal in the last minute of the match. This was the first time since mid-September last year that Wrexham lost a home league match. At the other end of the table, Newport County suffered another defeat in their battle for survival. Newport are now only one point above the relegation zone, even though they have games in hand over their rivals. Lincoln took the lead when Mark McCammon scored with a header after 25 minutes. Shortly after, Nutter doubled the home team's advantage with a free kick. Although Newport have reached the FA Trophy final, they have now failed to win any of their last five league matches.
